body: Candidates (audit 25-Nov-2026): (1) single mean/median convention for scenario multiples (correctness; ~6-8% EV effect); (2) explicit margin of safety in the hurdle if wanted (currently implicit ~2pp from mechanics; hurdle = 1.12^5 index CAGR); (3) anchor the right tail P(>=3x) too; (4) sigma toward class log-SD ~0.68; (5) warn when P(bear)>P(bull) and scenario mean < base; (6) warn on deprecated null-tail base-rate class. Evaluation rule: after the Jan-Feb 2027 season, compare Brier/calibration of raw vs anchored tails and of card EV vs realized; adopt (1),(5),(6) as correctness/warnings regardless; adopt (2)-(4) only if they improve calibration on resolved calls. Never lower the hurdle just to open cards. Note: the audit says the 6 names were 'chosen as candidates'; in fact dives #1,#3-#6 were seeded random draws within frames (dive #2 US-KEX frame per its file) — the zeros still say nothing about market fairness because a fair-priced name scores 0 by design.
title: Pre-registered card fixes from the no-machine audit: evaluate at first scoring season, apply none before
